parameters.content:
Purpose: answer supported general clinic questions from a local proof-of-concept knowledge base derived from ODT source files.

Notes:
- Accepts direct JSON or Vapi custom-tool webhook body
- Uses simple keyword scoring over curated knowledge entries
- Returns no answer when the question is outside the curated scope

  .replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '')

  .replace(/[^a-z0-9\s-]/g, ' ')
  .split(/\s+/)
  .map((token) => token.trim())
  .filter((token) => token.length >= 3 && !stopWords.has(token))));

const getEntryAnswer = (entry) => request.language === 'en' && entry.answerEn ? entry.answerEn : entry.answerPl;

const normalizedQuery = normalize(request.query);
const scored = knowledge.map((entry) => {
  let score = 0;
  const normalizedTags = [...(entry.tags || []), ...(entry.tagsEn || [])].map(normalize);
  const normalizedTitles = [entry.title, entry.titleEn].filter(Boolean).map(normalize);
  const normalizedExamples = [...(entry.queryExamples || []), ...(entry.queryExamplesEn || [])].map(normalize);
  const combined = combinedFields(entry).map(normalize).join(' ');
  const matchedTokens = queryTokens.filter((token) => combined.includes(token));
  for (const token of queryTokens) {
    if (normalizedTags.includes(token)) score += 4;
    if (normalizedTitles.some((title) => title.includes(token))) score += 3;
    if (normalizedExamples.some((example) => example.includes(token))) score += 2;
    if (combined.includes(token)) score += 1;
  }
  const exactTitleMatch = normalizedTitles.some((title) => title === normalizedQuery || title.includes(normalizedQuery));
  const exactExampleMatch = normalizedExamples.some((example) => example.includes(normalizedQuery));
  if (exactTitleMatch) score += 6;
  if (exactExampleMatch) score += 5;
  const minimumMatchedTokens = queryTokens.length <= 1 ? 1 : 2;
  const strongSignal = exactTitleMatch || exactExampleMatch || matchedTokens.length >= minimumMatchedTokens;
  const tokenCoverage = queryTokens.length === 0 ? 0 : matchedTokens.length / queryTokens.length;
  return {
    ...entry,
    score,
    tokenCoverage,
    exactTitleMatch,
    exactExampleMatch,
    strongSignal
  };
}).filter((entry) => {
  if (entry.score < 4) return false;
  if (!entry.strongSignal) return false;
  if (queryTokens.length <= 1) return true;
  return entry.tokenCoverage >= 0.75 || entry.exactTitleMatch || entry.exactExampleMatch;
}).sort((left, right) => right.score - left.score || right.tokenCoverage - left.tokenCoverage || getEntryTitle(left).localeCompare(getEntryTitle(right)));
const matches = scored.slice(0, request.limit).map((entry) => ({
  id: entry.id,
  title: getEntryTitle(entry),
  category: entry.category,
  sourceDocument: entry.sourceDocument,
  answer: getEntryAnswer(entry),
  score: entry.score
}));
const found = matches.length > 0;
const message = request.language === 'en'
  ? (found ? 'I found an answer in the local knowledge base.' : 'I could not find a reliable answer in the local knowledge base.')
  : (found ? 'Znalazlem odpowiedz w lokalnej bazie wiedzy.' : 'Nie znalazlem pewnej odpowiedzi w lokalnej bazie wiedzy.');
return [{ json: {
  requestId: request.requestId,
  toolCallId: request.toolCallId,
  found,
  answer: found ? matches[0].answer : null,
  matches,
  message
} }];
